orchestrator.name: Chief of Staff Agent
orchestrator.role: Interpret requests, assign work to specialist agents, review their responses, resolve conflicts, and produce the final executive brief.

specialist_agents.name: Innovation Agent
specialist_agents.purpose: Discover, assess, prioritize, and advance innovation opportunities.
route_when: The request involves identifying new opportunities.
An idea requires feasibility, value, or impact assessment.
An opportunity needs a pilot or experimentation plan.

specialist_agents.name: Compliance Agent
specialist_agents.purpose: Identify applicable requirements, assess compliance risks and controls, and escalate material concerns.
route_when: The request involves laws, regulations, policies, or standards.
Privacy, security, records, accessibility, or governance risks require review.
A proposal needs a compliance finding or escalation decision.

specialist_agents.name: Project Management Agent
specialist_agents.purpose: Plan initiatives, monitor execution, and manage risks, assumptions, issues, decisions, and dependencies.
route_when: An approved initiative requires a project plan.
Progress, milestones, dependencies, or status require management.
Risks, assumptions, issues, or decisions require tracking.

specialist_agents.name: Data Analyst Agent
specialist_agents.purpose: Prepare and assess data, perform analysis, and communicate evidence through visualizations and executive narratives.
route_when: The request requires quantitative evidence or data-quality assessment.
Data must be analyzed to produce findings or insights.
Results require visualization or an executive narrative.
